dedupe_keys.name: eu27 coswat dataset water availability water demand and river water quality under land allocation optimization scenarios

description: Albert Nkwasa at IIASA publishes EU27 CoSWAT hydrological and water-quality outputs for Nature-3B land-allocation scenarios and biodiversity variants. The August 2026 deposit provides TIFF grids in six 7z archives, free under CC BY 4.0. The README identifies annual averages over 2010–2019: river flow in cubic metres per second, water yield and agricultural evapotranspiration in millimetres per year, and river total nitrogen loads in kilograms of nitrogen per year. Blue and green evapotranspiration distinguish irrigated and rainfed contributions. File names encode the allocation task, biodiversity variant and baseline or sparing scenario. These outputs can inform water-demand and source-quality assumptions in infrastructure simulations. They are decade-average model results, so seasonal peaks and daily low-flow conditions cannot be inferred from them. Grid-cell size and full scenario definitions remain unknown from the inspected summary. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these scenario outputs; archives were not downloaded.
